checklists.title: Before you start writing
items: I know the one thing this piece should do
I know who the reader is
I have a clear main point or story
I have enough material or research
I know the length and format

checklists.title: Research checklist
items: I have defined the question I need to answer
I found reliable, citable sources
I distinguished primary and secondary sources
I took notes in my own words
I recorded the source for every fact or idea
I checked that sources are current and relevant

checklists.title: Article checklist
items: Title states a clear outcome
Introduction promises something the piece delivers
Each section has one job
Headings match their sections
I included specific examples or evidence
Conclusion gives a clear takeaway

checklists.title: Essay checklist
items: Thesis is specific and arguable
Each body paragraph supports one point
Paragraphs build in a logical order
Evidence supports every claim
Conclusion ties it together without new claims
I answer the exact question set

checklists.title: Academic writing checklist
items: I answer the question set
I have a clear thesis or argument
All non-original claims are cited
Citations follow the required style
I used a measured academic tone
The work is genuinely my own

checklists.title: Professional email checklist
items: Subject line names the subject
I get to the point quickly
I state exactly what I need and by when
One main topic per email
I attached what I promised
I proofread before sending

checklists.title: Blog post checklist
items: Headline states a specific outcome
Intro makes a clear promise
I used headings so readers can skim
Short paragraphs and lists
Content is specific and original
Clear next step at the end

checklists.title: Creative writing checklist
items: I have one clear moment or change
Character has a want, a flaw and a stake
There is real conflict
Descriptions are concrete, not general
Dialogue reveals character and moves the story
Everything serves the central effect

checklists.title: Editing checklist
items: I left the draft to cool
I fixed structure and argument first
I strengthened the opening and closing
I removed repetition and filler
I improved sentence flow
I checked each paragraph has one job

checklists.title: Proofreading checklist
items: I proofread on a fresh surface
I read aloud or backward
I handled one error type at a time
I checked homophones and double words
I verified names, numbers and dates
I did a final full pass

checklists.title: Submission checklist
items: I read the publication's official guidelines
I follow the exact submission method
My piece matches the word count and format
I included the required clips or bio
I checked eligibility and rights
I recorded my submission date

checklists.title: Final publication checklist
items: The piece is edited and proofread
The headline and meta description are ready
I added relevant links and alt text
I checked on the exact publish page
I promoted or shared it where appropriate
I recorded how it performed
